description_expanded: OverviewSteps to Heated Community Pool - Public Beach - 5 Minute Walk - Renovated - `Texas Tide` - 4 bikes includedThe SpaceQUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Steps to Community Pool – Heated Nov-Jan 1st, March 15th-May 15th 4 Bikes Included – Explore 30A with ease Tennis Courts & Playground – Perfect for families Wi-Fi Included – Stay connected Biking Distance to Seaside – Enjoy shopping & dining nearby Driveway - 2 Cars – Convenient parking Professionally Managed – 24/7 Guest SupportWelcome to Texas TideTexas Tide is a beautiful newly renovated 3-bedroom, 3-bath home perfectly situated steps from the community pool and a very short walk to Seagrove Beach. Enjoy the sugary white sand as well as the peaceful beach experience. Texas Tide is a short stroll or bike ride (with 4 bikes provided) to Seaside as well as many great restaurants and shopping. Enjoy the serene quiet environment yet very walkable to all of the excitement along 30A!Located in the quaint community of Grove by the Sea, this coastal 30A vacation home has much to offer! The open concept living, kitchen and dining is upscale, stylish and fun providing many beach memories. The dining table can seat 8 and the kitchen bar can accommodate 5. The three French doors leading to the screen porch allows for additionally dining and cozy seating areas. The 60” Sony TV is sure to please along with free internet. Two King suites are uniquely decorated and offer private bathrooms. The bunk room has a set of full bunks and twin bunks with a trundle. The bunk room bath is adjacent. All bedrooms have a flat screen TV. The community features 2 pools, tennis courts and a playground.Enjoy making beach memories at Texas Tide that are sure to last a lifetime!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (11):Master bedroom: King sized bed; private bath with stand-up showerGuest bedroom: King sized bed; private bath with tub/shower comboGuest bedroom: One set of full bunks and one set of twin bunks with trundle; shared bathAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
